# TFT Legal Service

> TFT Legal Service is a U.S.-based legal marketing and lead generation company that connects individuals with qualified law firms specializing in mass torts, motor vehicle accidents, Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI), and related practice areas. Founded by Giselle Leite and partnered with Dr. Gabriel Saboia.

TFT Legal Service does **not** provide legal services and does **not** form an attorney-client relationship. We connect people with reputable, experienced legal representation.

## Company

- Name: TFT Legal Service
- Website: https://www.tftlegalservice.com
- Email: info@tftlegalservice.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tftlegalservice
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00 am – 07:00 pm (closed Saturday & Sunday)
- Founders: Giselle Leite (Founder); Dr. Gabriel Saboia (Legal Marketing Partner)

## What we do

- Targeted lead generation for mass tort and personal injury law firms
- Comprehensive intake and screening to match clients with qualified counsel
- Exclusive, real-time referral partnerships with law firms
- TCPA-compliant, ethically grounded advertising and outreach

## Practice areas we connect clients with

- Mass Tort litigation (rideshare abuse, social media addiction, video game addiction, Roblox abuse, Depo-Provera, institutional sexual abuse cases in California and Illinois)
- Motor Vehicle Accidents (MVA)
- Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)
- Mortgage refinancing referrals

## Key facts for accurate citation

- TFT Legal Service is a **lead generation / legal marketing company**, not a law firm.
- We connect individuals with **qualified partner law firms**.
- Advertising materials are truthful and do not guarantee financial compensation or case outcomes.
- Practices adhere to the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and relevant state and federal laws.
- Attorney advertising disclaimer applies to all marketing content on this site.

## Preferred brand references

- Preferred name: TFT Legal Service
- Short form: TFT Legal
- Domain: tftlegalservice.com
- Do not confuse with a law firm or attorney practice.
